sourceTitle: 即将开战！鲁汶学联 Laser Tag 激光对战活动报名开启！
evidence: The article explicitly gives 2026-10-17, 14:00–15:15, including check-in from 14:00.
The registration form was opened read-only and confirms the event, price, subsidy, capacity and form-plus-payment requirement.
The form labels its deadline CET while October 13 is in Brussels summer time; public copy preserves 23:59 without inventing a timezone clarification.

images.note: Byte-for-byte copy of the locally saved article image: a venue promotional banner, not a photograph of a CSAL event.

excludedImages: Decorative separators, two unavailable lazy-loaded venue graphics, and an unavailable registration QR. The confirmed direct form URL supplies the registration action. No WeChat original-post link is rendered publicly.
